source_name: NEU surface defect database (NEU-DET)
license: No license stated on the official page
original_class: scratches; also rolled-in scale, patches, crazing, pitted surface, inclusion
notes: Official page describes 1,800 grayscale images, 300 for each of 6 classes, and points detection users to NEU-DET. Bytes not included. A citation request is not a reuse license. Pitted surface was not mapped to corrosion or weld_porosity.

source_name: GC10-DET metallic surface defect dataset
original_class: 10 steel-sheet defect types including welding line, inclusion, crease, rolled pit
notes: The Sensors paper (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7146379/) describes 3,570 images. Dataset Ninja states 2,300 images. This build did not download the files, so neither count was remeasured. The Roboflow Universe page https://universe.roboflow.com/nanjing-university-of-information-science-and-technology/gc10-det-zukta was fetched on 2026-10-08 and did not display a license. Bytes not included. Welding line was not mapped to weld_porosity or weld_crack.

source_name: Kolektor Surface-Defect Dataset 2
license: Not stated on the official page fetched 2026-10-08
original_class: surface defects described as scratches, minor spots, and surface imperfections; not split into the seven project classes
notes: Official page: 356 images with visible defects, 2,979 without, about 230x630 pixels, train 246 positive and 2,085 negative, test 110 positive and 894 negative. Secondary pages disagree on the license (one Hugging Face card says CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; Dataset Ninja says CC BY-SA 4.0). Bytes not included.

source_name: MVTec Anomaly Detection
original_class: 15 object and texture categories with pixel masks; paper examples include scratches, dents, and missing parts
notes: License is clear, but the download is form-gated and no bytes were retrieved. The paper abstract and Table 1 describe 5,354 images (3,629 train, 467 good test, 1,258 defective test) and 73 defect groups. Metal nut: 220 train, 22 good test, 93 defective, 4 defect groups. Screw: 320 train, 41 good test, 119 defective, 5 defect groups. Masks are category-specific and were not converted into the seven project classes.

source_name: RIAWELC radiographic weld dataset
license: README says released freely; no SPDX license was stated in the retrieved README
original_class: lack of penetration, porosity, cracks, no defect
notes: 24,407 radiographic 224x224 images. Radiographs are not camera images of an enclosure surface, so porosity and cracks were not mapped into weld_porosity or weld_crack. Bytes not included.

source_name: LoHi-WELD
license: README grants research, non-commercial, and commercial use with citation; no SPDX name
notes: README describes 3,022 annotated weld-bead images. Redistribution of a copy inside this repository is not explicitly granted, so bytes were not included. Pores would be the closest public match to weld_porosity if a redistribution grant existed.

source_name: Welding Defect - Object Detection (Kaggle, Hugging Face mirror inspected)
license: CC0 claimed on the Kaggle page; contents are not clean enough to redistribute
notes: Kaggle page metadata says CC0. The Hugging Face mirror https://huggingface.co/datasets/l985215117/welding-defect-object-detection is also tagged cc0-1.0. A local snapshot on 2026-10-08 contained 2,028 JPEG files (train 1,619, valid 283, test 126) and data.yaml names Bad Weld, Good Weld, Defect. One test file whose name contains porosity-worm-hole visibly includes a Shutterstock watermark. Filenames also include Screenshot (122 files), 260nw stock-preview ids (6 files), and .rf. Roboflow suffixes (1,315 filename groups before that suffix). Bytes were not added to this repository. The three source classes were not mapped onto the seven project classes.
